versions.content: CpSoftwareClusterToApplicationPartitionMapping aggregated by SystemMapping supersedes CpSoftwareClusterToApplica- tionPartitionMapping aggregated by CpSoftwareClusterMappingSet If a CpSoftwareClusterToApplicationPartitionMapping that is aggregated by the SystemMapping and a CpSoftwareClusterToApplicationPartition- Mapping that is aggregated by the CpSoftwareClusterMappingSet exist at the same time and both are mapping the same ApplicationPartition to the same CpSoftwareCluster then the CpSoftwareClusterToApplicationPar- titionMapping that is aggregated by the SystemMapping supersedes the Cp- SoftwareClusterToApplicationPartitionMapping that is aggregated by the CpSoftwareClusterMappingSet .
